proposal.reason: Main functional change is copy-engine behavior: CE memcpy vs ltOki ring isolation, memcpy stream hinting, OKI feature negotiation across ranks, and OKI QP/ring allocation/launch policy updates. Add symmetric because there are independently substantive device-side symmetric OKI fixes (AR/RS tail chunk sizing, pre-broadcast clamping, lane-slice alignment, and slot/lane active-byte checks) that affect collective correctness.
